description: Aggregate multi-region sales CSVs excluding refunded rows
prompt: There are three CSV files under data/: east.csv, west.csv, and central.csv. Columns: product,quantity,unit_price,status (header row). Ignore rows whose status is not exactly `ok`. Produce summary.csv at the workspace root with columns product,revenue sorted by product ascending. revenue is the sum of quantity*unit_price for kept rows, formatted with exactly two decimals. Include a header row.
